summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend Playwright integration checks for calculator, navigation guards, games, browser proxy, chat, responsive layouts, and production build.

critical.issue: Live OpenRouter calls consistently returned 503; backend logs show upstream 429 rate-limit/quota responses.

ui_bugs.issue: After evaluating 2+3, entering ans+2 via keypad produced 5 instead of 7 (ans token not composing correctly with subsequent operators).

integration_issues.issue: Both configured Wisp endpoints failed websocket handshake (Sec-WebSocket-Protocol not accepted). App correctly surfaced failover attempts and unavailable state.
Console captured PAGE ERROR: blocker.reset is not a function during navigation/confirmation flow (intermittent).

action_items: Fix calculator ans token composition so chained expressions (ans+2) evaluate correctly.
Investigate LeaveConfirmation blocker API usage for React Router v7; remove blocker.reset runtime error path.
Resolve OpenRouter provider quota/rate-limit state or model/key constraints (currently causing 503 from backend).
Coordinate with proxy endpoint owners for Wisp handshake compatibility; app failover UI is functioning but upstream endpoints were unavailable.
critical_code_review_comments: LeaveConfirmation uses blocker.reset/proceed assumptions that can throw at runtime with current router behavior.
Settings switches emit uncontrolled->controlled warnings; initialize boolean defaults to avoid runtime warnings.
Frontend production JS bundle is large (1.36 MB gzip); consider additional code splitting/per-route optimization.
seed_data_creation: Created test status entries and temporary chat sessions via API during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is in /app/backend/tests/test_core_endpoints.py and currently passes except chat live-call test skipped due upstream 503. Frontend: calculator core math, settings persistence, internal leave confirm (stay/leave), browser back blocking, native beforeunload, data-testid uniqueness, and responsive overflow checks passed. Browser proxy could not connect to either configured Wisp endpoint but failover UX worked. Google Dino and 2048 loaded in sandbox iframe; 2048 showed a blocked font resource (NotSameOrigin) but remained playable.
rca of the issue: 1) Chat 503 RCA: backend maps OpenRouter non-200 to 503; backend logs show repeated upstream HTTP 429, so failure is provider quota/rate-limit rather than route wiring. 2) Wisp availability RCA: websocket handshake failed for both configured endpoints with protocol negotiation error, while app correctly rendered attempt statuses and unavailable fallback. 3) ans bug RCA hypothesis: keypad insert() uses insertionMode=replaceSelection/selectionMode=placeholder; ans token likely keeps/changes selection so subsequent operator/number clicks do not append as expected. 4) blocker runtime RCA: PAGE ERROR indicates blocker.reset access path can be undefined during certain dialog transitions with current router blocker object lifecycle.
